capabilities: Transcribe Douyin and TikTok videos into Markdown notes
OCR Douyin image posts into Markdown
Scrape WeChat Official Account articles into Markdown
Fetch timestamped YouTube transcripts with channel metadata
Auto-import files dropped into a watched inbox folder
extras: Not yet approved for the community plugin store (manifest states it has not been manually reviewed); install via BRAT until approved. Desktop-only, minimum Obsidian 1.4.0. The plugin makes no direct internet calls; only the local backend does, forwarding audio/images to SiliconFlow for ASR/OCR. Known limits: YouTube transcripts fail when captions are disabled, WeChat login-walled articles cannot be extracted, WeChat images may not load due to Referer restrictions, and Douyin OCR takes ~5s per image.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn social media and video links into readable Markdown notes with transcripts, article text, or OCR of images.

relations.evidence: The backend is a separate FastAPI service that you run locally
it forwards the audio / image to whichever provider you've configured your API key with (SiliconFlow by default)

summary: Imports Douyin, TikTok, WeChat, and YouTube links as Markdown notes by sending them to a local backend for transcription, scraping, or OCR.
